title: Ridgecrest phase picking
summary: Preprocess the approved Ridgecrest waveform subset and produce P/S phase picks.
task_prompt: Read the waveform and StationXML files listed in the input manifest and produce a reproducible phase-picking result. Inspect trace metadata and report the preprocessing applied without modifying the input files. For each accepted P or S pick, record the station, channel, phase, UTC arrival time, and confidence or probability when available. Write the required preprocessing and picks artifacts to the declared output paths. Keep the output self-contained, preserve uncertain or missing results explicitly, and use only the declared inputs and the task runtime environment.
